1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves incorrect syntax highlighting of comments in Python code when a comment is placed on the same line as a decorator (e.g., '@pytest.mark.asyncio  # comment'). The entire line is styled with the class for decorators ('hljs-meta'), instead of recognizing and highlighting the comment section ('# ...') with the proper comment styling ('hljs-comment'). The screenshot further confirms that, in the rendered output, the comment after the decorator does not appear visually distinguished as a comment, indicating the parser fails to switch to comment mode once it encounters a '#' in this context.
